events.event_description: Breakthrough as child star in National Velvet

events.event_description: First marriage, to hotel heir Conrad "Nicky" Hilton Jr.

events.event_description: Divorce from Conrad Hilton Jr. after eight months

events.event_description: Marriage to singer Eddie Fisher amid public scandal
events.evidence_text: Taylor wed Eddie Fisher in 1959, a widely criticised affair-turned-marriage.

events.event_description: Signed record US$1 million contract for Cleopatra

events.event_description: Near-fatal pneumonia requiring emergency tracheotomy in London

events.event_description: Academy Award for Best Actress (BUtterfield 8)

events.event_description: First divorce from Richard Burton

events.event_description: Surgery to remove a benign brain tumour
events.evidence_text: Underwent surgery in 1997 to remove a benign brain tumour.

events.event_description: Marriage to makeup artist Lori Anne Allison
events.evidence_text: Depp married Lori Anne Allison in 1983.

events.evidence_text: Made his film debut in A Nightmare on Elm Street (1984).

events.event_description: Divorce from Lori Anne Allison
events.evidence_text: Marriage to Allison ended in divorce in 1985.

events.event_description: Birth of daughter Lily-Rose with Vanessa Paradis
events.evidence_text: Daughter Lily-Rose born to Depp and Vanessa Paradis in 1999.

events.event_description: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl global hit; first Oscar nomination
events.evidence_text: Jack Sparrow role brought a blockbuster and Best Actor Oscar nomination.

events.event_description: The Lone Ranger box-office flop
events.evidence_text: The Lone Ranger lost heavily for Disney, a notable flop.

events.event_description: Marriage to Amber Heard

events.event_description: Sued former managers alleging mismanagement and large losses; reported financial crisis
events.evidence_text: Lawsuit against The Management Group exposed his serious money troubles.

events.event_description: Lost UK libel case against The Sun

events.event_description: Asked to step down from Fantastic Beasts franchise
events.evidence_text: Warner Bros. asked Depp to resign his Grindelwald role.

events.event_description: Won US defamation trial against Amber Heard
events.evidence_text: Virginia jury largely found for Depp, awarding over $10 million.

events.event_description: Marriage to Eleanor Neil

events.evidence_text: Dementia 13 was his first mainstream directing credit.

events.evidence_text: Co-won the screenplay Oscar for Patton.

events.event_description: Birth of daughter Sofia Coppola
events.evidence_text: Daughter Sofia born in 1971.

events.evidence_text: The Godfather won Best Picture and became the top-grossing film.

events.evidence_text: Coppola won Best Director and Picture for The Godfather Part II.

events.evidence_text: Apocalypse Now shared the Cannes Palme d'Or in 1979.

events.evidence_text: Debts after One from the Heart forced the sale of the Zoetrope studio lot.

events.event_description: The Godfather Part III released to mixed reviews
events.evidence_text: Part III received mixed reviews despite seven Oscar nominations.

events.event_description: Bram Stoker's Dracula a commercial hit, restoring finances

events.evidence_text: He financed Megalopolis himself, selling a share of his winery holdings.

events.event_description: Megalopolis box-office failure
events.evidence_text: Megalopolis grossed a small fraction of its budget.

events.event_description: Contracted polio as a child, leaving right leg weakened
events.evidence_text: Polio at about age six left her right leg thinner.

events.event_description: Began painting seriously during recovery
events.evidence_text: She began painting during months of bedridden recovery.

events.evidence_text: They remarried in San Francisco in December 1940.

events.event_description: Hospitalised about nine months, multiple spinal operations

events.event_description: First solo exhibition in Mexico, attended on a bed
events.evidence_text: Attended her first Mexican solo show carried in on her bed.

events.event_description: Right leg amputated below the knee due to gangrene
